subject: ARTJ
title: Special Topics in Japanese Aesthetic Practices
info: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated in the same term or separate terms, if topics vary, to a maximum of 12 hours.

sections.sectionText: Topic: Ikebana (Japanese Flower Arrangement), Through lectures, selected readings, and hands-on experience of Ikebana (the art of Japanese flower arrangement), students will gain new perspectives and appreciation for the beauty of nature while exploring the artistic techniques and traditions of Japanese floral arts. Instructor approval required. Students must apply at https://go.illinois.edu/ikebana

subject: ARTJ
title: Chado (The Way of Tea)
info: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule.

sections.sectionText: The main theme of this course is the exploration of how the Japanese Tea Ceremony can be applied to everyday life. Through the study of the Tea Ceremony and the Zen worldview, it is hoped that students will acquire a better understanding of Japanese culture and also come to see their own culture in a new light. This section is for Chancellor's Scholars.

subject: ARTJ
title: Seminar in Japanese Aesthetics
info: May be repeated in the same term or separate terms, if topics vary, to a maximum of 12 hours.

sections.sectionText: Topic: Zen Heart, Tea Mind. This course examines the meaning, history, and people connected to popular phrases found in Zen Buddhism and in the world of Japanese tea ceremony. This course is comprised of online lectures/discussions and two in-person activity days on 1/21 and 3/11. Students are required to register for the online lecture and in-person section. 2 seats are reserved for ARTJ minors. On 12/1 any remaining seats will become available to all majors.

restrictions: Restricted to Graphic Design or History of Art or Art Education or Art History or Art and Design or Art Undeclared or Studio Art or Art and Art History or Japanese Arts and Aesthetics or Industrial Design major(s) or minor(s).
sections.sectionText: Some seats are reserved for A&D majors, A&D minors, and Japanese Arts & Aesthetics Minors. If you receive a "reserve closed" error, all seats for your major are filled, check back on December 1. Any available seats left on December 1 will be made available to all majors.
